formal_scope: JRA main race STEP2 purchase and publication overlay; STEP1 engine stays SHA-pinned v3.13
large_verified_odds_range: odds >= 100 with at least 10,000 yen potential payout per winning 100 yen ticket
approval_requirement: No per-race user approval is required for a validated data update; UI/layout redesign still requires staging and explicit approval.
mandatory_sequence: Read latest_prompt.json and current v3.13 SHA-pinned STEP1 formal workflow; prepare/prerace validate fresh exact-odds source before race start.

Before telling users the prediction is complete, create a distinct immutable v3.15 request for every JRA main race, run .github/workflows/jra-prerace-formal-3action-v315.yml, and wait for verified success.
Publish only the v3.15 actual purchase commands and source-verified final_bets as the sole current races.json reference; preserve v3.13 preliminary 60-ticket originals as historical source only.
Verify new v3.15 snapshot/proof, complete one-A4-page-per-horse PDF, JRA purchase expansion, HTML, canonical registry and public HTTP exact binary match.
If quotes are >600s old, rerun v3.13 full-odds source collection and retry v3.15 before start; if race begins or blocker persists, report incomplete instead of promoting stale tickets.
currently_unautomated: The standard v3.13 intake workflow does not itself chain v3.15. The JRA one-shot executor (human or assistant) MUST launch the second v3.15 request; no user approval is needed for a validated data-only publication. This is an execution-orchestration item, not permission to publish 60-point v3.13 as completed.

presentation_quality_gate.scope: human-readable report HTML/PDF and one A4 page per horse only; do not alter v3.13 STEP1, marks, prices or tickets
guards: all 9 named factors and grade palette
show source-supported evidence and readable prior results
block rather than publish when page count or content fail
A+/A/B+/B/B-/C grade-chip colors must render in extracted PDF spans
Grade colors (A+/A/B+/B/B-/C): exact #RGB values of approved v3.13 CSS, validated both in generated HTML and PDF colored rectangle fills
Mobile responsive meta viewport is identical in staged and future formal production renderer
All horse report pages in HTML/PDF strictly ordered ◎→○→▲→△→× using only frozen source mark; keep original source order within each mark
presentation_quality_gate.approval_note: This stage-only proposed UI/layout change requires explicit approval before updating main; original v3.15 results, STEP1, purchase instructions and historical reports remain immutable.

reader_v1_compatibility.constraints: No historical files rewritten, no CSS or model changes; reader-visible SHA prohibited. Future live prestart publication requires fresh PDF validation and public HTTP matching.
